# Dr. Om Gurram

> Dr. Om Gurram is a dentist and health tech founder from Solapur and Pune, co-founder of OroCare AI and founder of the CastleBlock tech community.

Full name: Om Jayant Gurram. Also written as Om Gurram or Dr. Gurram. Handles: omg14doteth (X), theantideather (GitHub, Instagram).
Other people share the name Om Gurram. This file is about the dentist and founder of OroCare AI and CastleBlock.

## Who he is

- Dentist: BDS, Sinhgad Dental College, Pune (Maharashtra University of Health Sciences), 2026.
- Lives and works between Solapur and Pune, Maharashtra, India.
- Co-founder and Technical Director of OroCare AI (since August 2023): diagnostic AI for dental X-rays, OPGs and cephalograms; OroCare Sim (VR clinical OS); VR OroCare Museum; Dentalverse (dental research engine); a multilingual voice interface for rural patients. Clinical review with practising dentists is under way.
- Co-founder of ResQ (Life ResQ Healthcare Systems LLP) with Dr. Sameer Patil: AI emergency response for clinics. Dr. Om Gurram is the clinical side.
- Founder of CastleBlock (since March 2022), a developer community with city chapters. The Solapur chapter is led by Aksha Gurram.
- Former strategic advisor to PathPulse.ai (November 2024 to 2026).
- Spoke at the World Health Conference, Jio World Centre (October 2024), as an undergraduate dental student.
